title: Sr. Fullstack Engineer - Growth & Retention
description:
Vi bygger Nordens största streamingtjänst som i snitt når cirka åtta miljoner nordbor i veckan genom TV4 Play och vår finska motsvarighet MTV Katsomo. Inom Product & Tech utvecklar vi de tekniska lösningar som bland annat gör det möjligt att streama innehåll, söka och få rekommendationer - så att människor kan ta del av nyheter, sport och underhållning, när och var de vill.
   

  

 Som Sr. Fullstack Engineer i Growth & Retention arbetar du i ett tvärfunktionellt team med stort tekniskt ägandeskap. Teamet ansvarar för kritiska tjänster kopplade till betal- och prenumerationstjänster, autentisering, användardata och partnerskap. Fokus ligger på robusta, skalbara och säkra system som används av alla våra klienter: webb, Smart TV samt mobil- och TV-appar.
   

  

**Ansvarsområden**
* Designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla skalbara mikrotjänster och API:er med fokus på prestanda, säkerhet och tillgänglighet.
* Agentisk utveckling är centralt i vårt arbete - vi arbetar idag med Claude Code och OpenAI Codex. Alla förväntas arbeta aktivt med att optimera våra arbetssätt kring dagens och framtidens AI-verktyg.
* Utveckla play-tjänster på webb, mobil samt tv-appar.
* Driva och äga projekt och spännande features tillsammans med kollegor med olika kompetenser.
* Förbättra kodbasen med fokus på kvalitet och säkerhet.
* Driva tekniska initiativ och stötta teamet i arkitektur- och teknikval.


 För att lyckas i rollen är du en erfaren Fullstack Engineer med djup inom backend. Du trivs med ägandeskap, komplexa system och att arbeta nära affären. Du har ett gediget systemtänk, bryr dig om kodkvalitet, säkerhet och drivs av att bygga stabila plattformar som klarar hög belastning. Du ser AI som ett naturligt verktyg för att effektivisera utveckling och höja kvalitén i teamet.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* Har minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling i moderna system och som kan se helheten kring dina tekniska lösningar och hur de passar in i ett större sammanhang.
* Är van att arbeta med Node.js, TypeScript, React och molnbaserade lösningar.
* Har en fallenhet för systemtänk, du kan översätta den stora bilden till dess beståndsdelar och tillbaka.
* Har erfarenhet av snabbrörlig miljö med höga krav på självledarskap.
* Förstår att de flesta tekniska beslut sällan är svartvita, och söker aktivt rätt balans.
* Har anammat AI som verktyg för att lyfta din och ditt teams leverans.
* Nördar ner dig på riktigt när något fångar dig - oavsett om det handlar om distribuerade system, AI, eller matlagning. Du blir rastlös när du slutar lära dig.
* Är en god kommunikatör och kan förklara komplexa koncept på ett enkelt vis.


**Det är ett extra plus om du har:**
* Erfarenhet av streaming- eller mediaplattformar
* Erfarenhet av betallösningar och prenumerationstjänster
* Erfarenhet av autentisering och tjänster till inloggade användare
* Erfarenhet av Golang, GraphQL och React Native
* Arbetat med högtrafikerade system och distribuerade arkitekturer


**Nuvarande Tech Stack**
* Backend: primärt Node, Golang
* Frontend: React, React Native
* Moln: AWS
* Databaser: bl.a PostgreSQL, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch och DynamoDB
* DevOps & tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Terraform
* Utvecklarverktyg: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, CLI/MCP mot andra tools
* Produktivitet: Linear, Notion, Slack


****Vad TV4 erbjuder dig****
* Kort väg från idé till beslut. Vi är en senior tech-organisation med hög autonomi för team och individ.
* En kultur som värdesätter hållbar kod framför snabba genvägar. Vi prioriterar långsiktiga lösningar.
* Du loggar ut på riktigt efter jobbet. Vi har dedikerad on-call med frivilligt deltagande - du förväntas inte vara tillgänglig utanför arbetstid.

title: RedHat OpenShift Engineer
description:
**Role:** 
 RedHat OpenShift Engineer
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
 



**Is it Permanent / Contract:** 
 Contract for 6 months
 



**Is it Onsite/Remote/Hybrid:** 
 Onsite
 



  





**Job description for a Red Hat OpenShift Architect** 




 This is a job description for a Red Hat OpenShift Architect with proven experience migrating workloads from VMware (vSphere/onprem VMs) to Red Hat OpenShift (Kubernetes). The role focuses on solution architecture, migration planning and execution, platform automation, and ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available OpenShift-based platforms.
 



**Role Overview** 




 Lead architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise OpenShift platforms.
 



 Execute migration strategies for moving applications and data from VMware virtual machines and traditional architectures to containerized OpenShift environments.
 



 Work with cross-functional teams (Dev, Security, Networking, Storage) to deliver migration projects with minimal disruption and measurable business value.
 



  





**Required Qualifications & Experience** 




 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
 



 8+ years in enterprise infrastructure/cloud roles, with at least 3–5 years specifically designing and operating Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes platforms.
 



 Hands-on experience migrating applications and services from VMware/vSphere (on-prem) to OpenShift/Kubernetes.
 



 Strong knowledge of VMware stack: vSphere, vCenter, and familiarity with virtualization concepts, VM inventories, and dependency mapping.
 



 Expertise in OpenShift installation and configuration (IPI/UPI), cluster lifecycle, and operator model.
 



 Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, OpenShift CLI/oc).
 



 Solid understanding of networking (CNI plugins, load balancing, DNS), persistent storage and CSI drivers, and storage backends (NFS, Ceph/Rook, SAN).
 



 Experience with CI/CD and GitOps integration for container deployments.
 



 Familiar with backup, migration, and application portability tools (e.g., Velero, Red Hat Migrations/operand tools, image registries).
 



 Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python) and familiarity with container tooling (Docker, Podman).
 



 Experience defining security posture for Kubernetes/OpenShift (RBAC, OPA/Gatekeeper, secrets management).
 



 Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.
 



  





**Preferred / Nice-to-have** 




 Red Hat certifications: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration, RHCE, or RHCA.
 



 Experience with data migration for stateful applications and databases.
 



 Prior experience running large-scale multi-cluster OpenShift environments and hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute).

title: Tech Lead
description:
Du som vill ta ett tydligt tekniskt ansvar och samtidigt fortsätta skriva kod i vardagen kommer att trivas som
 **Tech Lead** 
 hos oss. Här får du kombinera din passion för utveckling med ett närvarande ledarskap och vara med och skapa lösningar som verkligen används.
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 Som Tech Lead på HiQ är du navet i den tekniska utvecklingen hos våra kunder. Du leder arbetet kring arkitektur, tekniska val och kvalitet och ser till att teamet levererar hållbara lösningar. Rollen är i hög grad praktisk och du arbetar nära kodbasen, där du växlar mellan att skriva kod, granska lösningar och driva förbättringar. Du samarbetar tätt med utvecklare, produktägare och andra intressenter och hjälper teamet att hitta smarta vägar framåt.
   

  

**Du kommer att:**
* Ta ansvar för tekniska vägval, arkitektur och övergripande design i teamet
* Arbeta hands on i kodbasen, utveckla nya funktioner och granska pull requests
* Coacha och stötta utvecklare i teamet
* Samarbeta nära produktägare och andra roller för att omvandla behov till robusta lösningar
* Driva förbättringar kring kvalitet, prestanda, säkerhet och utvecklingsprocesser


**Vi söker dig som har:**
* En ingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik eller liknande
* Flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling i komplexa miljöer, gärna minst sex år
* Erfarenhet av att ta en ledande teknisk roll, till exempel som Tech Lead
* Goda kunskaper i minst ett av språken Java, C++, Python eller C#
* Vana att arbeta i agila team och ett intresse för både teknik och samarbete
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
* Svenskt medborgarskap


 Meriterande är erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS, moderna arkitekturer samt CI/CD och automatiserade testflöden.
   

  

**Varför HiQ?**
 Som Tech Lead hos oss kliver du in i ett sammanhang där teknikintresse, nyfikenhet och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta i team som gillar att bolla idéer, prova nya angreppssätt och hitta lösningar tillsammans. Här finns goda möjligheter att forma din egen utveckling, både som teknisk specialist och som ledare nära kund och team.
   

  

 Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklar världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi har alltid haft två tydliga fokus: att ha roligt på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna – det är det som driver oss framåt. Som HiQare är vi stolta över en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål och vi lägger stor vikt vid att hjälpa varandra att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du inte bara möjlighet att bygga din egen kompetens, utan också chansen att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.

title: Security Engineering Director
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 At Legora, security is the foundation of the trust our customers place in us. The world's leading law firms and largest corporations use our platform for their most sensitive matters. The risk of breach is very high, and we treat it that way.
   

  

 We are building an engineering-led security function: secure defaults, paved roads, automation, and measurable risk reduction not advisory gates or ticket queues.
   

  

 We need a Director of Security Engineering to
 **set the direction for security across our product, platform, and cloud estate; build and lead the team; and tackle systemic problems rather than continually react to individual ones.** 
 You will work closely with engineering leadership to anticipate challenges, influence architecture and priorities, and make blockers and consequences clear.
   

  

 This role can be based in Stockholm or New York. It is a 5-day in-office role we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 Security strategy and architecture
   

  

* Define the security standard across Legora's product, platform, and customer commitments.
* Set the roadmap and investment priorities, looking ahead and identifying emerging risks and blockers early.
* Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership on architecture and technical direction.


 Engineering enablement
   

  

* Build tools, paved paths, and secure defaults that help teams ship securely without friction.
* Embed security into the software lifecycle through reviews, standards, and automation.
* Drive areas such as secrets management, workload identity, and Kubernetes hardening through infrastructure as code.


 Detection, response and agentic security
   

  

* Build automated detection and response, supported by specialist penetration testing.
* Own incident playbooks, exercises, and investigations.
* Threat-model our multi-tenant AI platform and define safe boundaries for coding agents.


 Team and enterprise readiness
   

  

* Hire and develop senior security engineers across Application Security, Detection Engineering & Response, and Cloud & Platform Security.
* Give the team the direction and focus to solve underlying problem themes, not just individual findings.
* Support enterprise customers through security conversations, questionnaires, and evidence of our practices.


**Who You Are**
* You have led and scaled a security engineering function through rapid product and team growth, ideally in an environment facing real threats.
* You have an engineering background rather than a purely corporate infosec or compliance background.
* You have strong architectural judgement and experience influencing technical direction at scale.
* You understand application security, detection engineering, and cloud and platform security, and how they fit together.
* You can operate as a peer to the engineering leadership, bringing security onto the agenda and making consequences and urgency clear.
* You communicate clearly, translate risk into engineering terms, and influence without relying on mandates.


**Nice to have**
* Experience securing LLM-based or agentic products.
* Experience building security at a high-growth SaaS company.
* Depth in more than one security specialisation.
* Experience with strict data confidentiality, data residency, or professional secrecy requirements.
* Experience representing security externally with enterprise customers, through research, or speaking.


 If you are close but not a perfect match, apply anyway and tell us what you would own.
   

  

**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: FDE (AI Engineer)
description:
**About Proxify** 




  





 Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Stockholm, Proxify helps 2,500+ companies worldwide scale their technical teams. The Financial Times ranked us as Sweden's 3rd fastest-growing company in 2025. Our clients increasingly need more than extra engineers. They need someone who can find where AI agents actually pay off and ship them into production.
 



  





**The challenge** 




  





 You're the AI engineer our clients have hired. You get close enough to their systems, data and processes to have a real opinion about what's worth automating and what isn't the right fit at the moment. You report to our Senior AI Product Manager and who owns discovery, commercials and scoping. The technical call is yours. Then you build it and lead Proxify engineers on the project, working within the client's existing data, integrations and security setup until it runs in production.
 



  





 You'll sit in our core team in Stockholm with several client builds running in parallel. Around 80% of your week is hands-on building. The other 20% goes to keeping clients up to date and flagging what the product manager needs to know, as well as collaborating with them.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  




* Get under the hood of each client's architecture, data and integrations.
* Turn a scoped brief into an agentic system running in the client's own environment, end to end.
* Lead the engineers on each project and set the technical direction.
* Be the client's day-to-day technical contact: updates, questions, and the things that were clear on paper but not in practice.
* Keep several projects moving at once, and surface scope changes instead of agreeing to them on the spot.



  





**Must-have** 




  




* 5+ years in software engineering, with a background in computer science, machine learning and generative AI.
* A track record of shipping LLM, RAG and agentic systems to production and keeping them running, with the depth to work out why a model behaves the way it does.
* Hands-on with RAG pipelines (vector databases, streaming, multi-tenancy), multiple LLM providers, and frameworks like LangChain, vLLM and PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Strong Python, solid engineering habits (version control, testing, code review) and containerized deployments on AWS, GCP or Azure.
* Quick to pick up an unfamiliar codebase and build inside someone else's stack.
* A solution-based, consultative approach. You start from the client's problem, not from the tool or product you'd like to sell them.
* A strong communicator in professional English. You can lead a client conversation and explain technical decisions to people who'll never read the code.
* Self-directed. You run with a brief without needing someone to check in on you.



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Things you've built on your own time, such as side projects, open source or agent experiments, and the story of why you built them.
* Real experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or the OpenAI Agents API.
* Time at a startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly.



  





**Why you'll like it** 




  





 You'll see a wide range of companies and problems in a short time, so the work never gets repetitive. There's no fixed playbook, so the ownership is real and the systems you build are yours to get right. You'll work directly with clients, with strong backing from leadership to move fast.
 



  





**Practical details** 




  




* Location: Stockholm preferred
* Travel: occasional client site visits
* Interview process: Talent Acquisition call → hiring manager interview → practical AI engineering assessment → final interview

title: Security Engineer - Enterprise Security Platform
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
   

  

 At Spotify, security helps make innovation possible. Our Enterprise Security team protects the systems and technology that support our employees and the more than 700 million people who use Spotify. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help strengthen our enterprise security across identity, devices, networks, and AI-powered tools. You'll build practical solutions, work with teams across the business, and help us create a secure environment where people can do their best work.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Improve enterprise security by identifying risks and implementing solutions that protect Spotify while supporting a great employee experience.
* Design and build security tools, integrations, and automation to make security processes more effective and scalable.
* Analyze security data to identify gaps, understand emerging risks, and guide improvements.
* Implement security controls across identity and access management, enterprise applications, endpoints, and cloud-based services.
* Assess security risks associated with AI tools and agents, and help develop safeguards that support responsible adoption.
* Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, and security teams to strengthen security across devices, networks, and enterprise systems.
* Evaluate and improve enterprise security technologies, including managed browsers and device security tools.
* Share your expertise and work with colleagues across technical and non-technical teams to make security practices clear, practical, and effective.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have a background in enterprise security or enterprise systems engineering, with experience improving the security of complex technology environments.
* You understand identity and access management (IAM), single sign-on (SSO), networking, and endpoint management.
* You can assess security risks, investigate technical challenges, and implement solutions that balance security with usability.
* You have experience using scripting, automation, or software integrations to solve technical problems.
* You're interested in securing AI-enabled environments and understanding the risks associated with AI agents and enterprise AI tools.
* You're comfortable exploring AI tools to improve your work while critically evaluating their outputs and security implications.
* You communicate technical ideas clearly and enjoy working with people across different teams and disciplines.
* You bring curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach to solving security challenges


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Deployment Strategist, Professional Services Global D&I
description:
**Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.**
 Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.
   

  

 Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.
   

  

 As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.
   

  

 We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
   

  

 Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Planet’s Professional Services team helps our Defense and Intelligence (D&I) customers adopt the Planet Platform and rapidly realize return on investment in Planet data and analytics. The Professional Services Global D&I team is looking for a Deployment Strategist responsible for the implementation, integration, and analysis of new software and data products that extend the Planet Platform and deliver new capabilities to our strategic D&I customers.
   

  

 In this role, you will be embedded with our customer to train users on Planet products, translate requirements, design workflows, and communicate with Planet’s product team on mission critical capabilities. Your work will be highly visible, directly impacting customers' ability to quickly access Planet's unprecedented datasets, as well as streamline the internal processes for adding new customers to our platform.
   

  

 This is a full-time, hybrid position based in one of our strategic customer locations 3 days a week in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

**Impact You’ll Own**
* Understand clients’ needs and deliver tailored solutions
* Break down ambiguous, high-stakes problems into clearly defined, solvable components
* Leverage analytical skills to deliver products to our D&I customers and support mission requirements
* Design workflows, defining data models, configuring integrations, and helping define tooling that aligns to the customer’s mission.
* Train users, iterate with them in real time, and ensure that Planet solutions become mission-critical to daily operations.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable product feedback for Planet’s engineering teams.
* Communicate technical capabilities back to customers in clear, mission-focused language.
* Rapidly prototype, test, and adjust workflows to match real operational needs.
* Map out high-level strategy with decision makers by sitting next to analysts to debug workflows.
* Work closely with customer teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and mission priorities.


**What You Bring**
* 6+ years of experience in supporting D&I customers, with specialized technical experience in the general areas of systems integration
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software, Systems Engineering, or similar
* Fluent in Golang, Python, Postgresql, & React or related technologies
* Experience with cloud deployments; GCP, AWS, Azure
* Solid problem-solving and systems thinking skills
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to quickly learn new technical domains and tools
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-pressure environments
* Deep curiosity and willingness to dive into operational details
* Fluency in translating between technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience with solving complex problems through analytical skills
* Experience scaling and maintaining production systems


**What Makes You Stand Out**
* Experience working with defense and intelligence organizations in Sweden
* Systems integrations experience working with multi domain/multi-level security architectures, particularly the Defence and Intelligence
* Working knowledge of JavaScript and its mapping libraries (OpenLayers, Leaflet, ArcGIS API for JavaScript), Google Earth Engine and its SDK
* Experience with RDBMS (PostgreSQL, SQL) and distributed databases (NoSQL)
* Experience in geopolitics and data science
* Ability to pick up new technologies quickly
* Experience with building analytical products from complex datasets

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
*We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.*
*When you join Tibber, you'll be part of building the tech that creates a real shift in how people consume electricity - good for our users, their wallets and the planet. We believe AI is how we accelerate that shift, and it's our people who lead it. The more we lean into AI, the more human judgment, curiosity and creativity matter.*
*We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join us - maybe that's you?*
**Job Mission 🚀**
 As a Fullstack Engineer, you’ll play a key role in electrifying our customers’ homes, helping them save money and use energy more sustainably. We’re growing our Electrification team with two engineers: one focused on the software tools our installers use, one on our online hardware store. Both report to the team’s Engineering Manager.
   

  

**What You'll Do ✅**
* Ship features end to end, working closely with your PM and designer.
* Co-own the team's codebases with the engineers already there, and keep them healthy as we grow.
* Help the team move to agentic development, making AI a natural part of how we build.
* Talk to stakeholders and turn their needs into technical requirements, together with your PM and EM.
* Installer focus: Build the tools installers rely on in the field, from our React Native app and its gateway to a new web presence in Next.js.
* Ecom focus: Build and improve Tibber's online hardware store in Next.js, and the services behind it. Right now that means checkout improvements and agentic features.


 We'll find the focus that suits you best together during the process.
   

  

**What We're Looking For⚡**
 You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability.
   

  

**We Believe You'll Thrive Here If You**
* Are strong in JS/TS and Node, and hands-on with React and Next.js. React Native, Expo or an ecommerce background is a plus.
* Have built or worked on event-driven systems.
* Are comfortable working in AWS, with tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, CircleCI and ArgoCD.
* Enjoy working closely with designers, PMs and fellow engineers to build great user experiences together.
* Are humble and transparent, and a generalist who enjoys covering many areas.
* Want AI in your daily dev loop. Tibber is becoming more AI-enabled, and you're excited to help our team make that shift.


 Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you. If this sounds like the role you want to grow into, apply!
   

  

**The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️**
*Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours, strengthening the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.*
*Being on a mission to change an industry means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can't be done - and we do it together. We win, fail and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better - every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we believe it's how we accelerate the energy transition. The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter.*
*Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Berlin, Amsterdam, Oslo and Førde. Backed by Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa and Schibsted. Still just getting started.*
*Diversity of thought fuels better products, so we welcome applicants of every background, identity and lived experience. Ready to be part of powering the energy transition?* 
***Apply below!***

title: IT-drifttekniker – bidra till en robust och säker IT-drift
description:
**Digitaliseringsavdelningen, Operativ IT-säkerhet**
 Regeringskansliet är mitt i en omfattande digital utveckling. Vi bygger moderna digitala tjänster, stärker informationshanteringen och utvecklar en säker och hållbar digital miljö för hela organisationen. För att lyckas behöver vi bli fler.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en eller flera DLC-tekniker som vill bidra till en stabil, säker och effektiv IT-drift. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhetskritisk miljö där tillgänglighet, säkerhet och kvalitet är avgörande för Sveriges regering och våra utlandsmyndigheter.
   

  

****Din arbetsdag. Sveriges morgondag.****
 Digitaliseringsavdelningen leder stora delar av Regeringskansliets digitala förflyttning. Vårt uppdrag är unikt. Våra lösningar används i hela Regeringskansliet och på över 100 utlandsmyndigheter världen över. Det du är med och utvecklar får direkt betydelse för hur Sveriges regering bedriver sitt arbete, både nationellt och globalt.
   

  

 Som en del av Operativ IT-säkerhet arbetar du i hjärtat av vår driftverksamhet där fokus ligger på övervakning, incidenthantering och kontinuerlig utveckling av vår IT-miljö. Tillsammans säkerställer vi att verksamheten har tillgång till robusta och säkra IT-tjänster.
   

  

****Om rollen****
 Som IT-drifttekniker arbetar du i Regeringskansliets driftledningscentral (DLC) med fokus på systemövervakning och hantering av incidenter i vår IT-miljö.
   

  

 Du dokumenterar, följer upp och leder arbetet med felsökning och avhjälpning av incidenter samt bidrar till att vidareutveckla Regeringskansliets systemövervakningsplattform. Rollen innebär också ett samordnande ansvar för DLC-funktionen där du leder möten, följer upp gruppens gemensamma arbetsinsatser och bidrar till att utveckla arbetssätt och rutiner.
   

  

 Arbetet innebär nära samverkan med tekniska specialister, supportfunktioner och andra delar av verksamheten för att säkerställa en stabil och säker driftmiljö.
   

  

**Hos oss får du**
* Arbeta med samhällsviktig IT-drift i en av Sveriges mest komplexa och säkerhetskänsliga miljöer.
* Vara en central del av Regeringskansliets driftledningscentral.
* Bidra till att upptäcka, hantera och följa upp incidenter i verksamhetskritiska system.
* Vara med och vidareutveckla arbetssätt och verktyg för övervakning och driftstyrning.
* Samarbeta med engagerade kollegor och specialister inom drift, säkerhet och digitalisering.
* Utvecklas i en organisation där teknik, verksamhet och samhällsnytta möts.


****Din bakgrund****
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

**Formella krav**
* Gymnasieexamen med IT-inriktning eller arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
* Mångårig erfarenhet av IT-support i större organisationer med fler än 3 000 medarbetare.
* Erfarenhet av administrativt arbete, exempelvis schemaläggning, driftsamordning eller motsvarande.
* God kunskap inom ärendehanteringssystem, exempelvis BMC Helix
* Goda kunskaper i Officepaketet.
* Erfarenhet av systemövervakningsplattformar, exempelvis SCOM, Zabbix
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* Svenskt medborgarskap.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av monitorering och larmhantering från exempelvis en NOC- eller driftövervakningsfunktion.
* Erfarenhet av ITIL-processer, exempelvis Incident Management, Problem Management och Change Management.
* Ledarskapsutbildning.
* Erfarenhet av att ha jobbat på Regeringskansliet
* Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper


****Dina egenskaper****
 Du är strukturerad och kommunikativ och har förmåga att skapa ordning, samordning och tydlighet i en verksamhet där många aktiviteter pågår samtidigt. Du tar ansvar för att driva frågor framåt och säkerställer att arbete följs upp och slutförs.
   

  

 Du är säkerhetsmedveten och har ett professionellt arbetssätt där kvalitet och noggrannhet är självklara delar av vardagen. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och därför är det viktigt att du har god samarbetsförmåga och kan skapa förtroendefulla relationer med både kollegor och andra intressenter.
   

  

 Regeringskansliets medarbetarkriterier är helhet, utveckling och resultat. Alla som arbetar i Regeringskansliet behöver ha helhetssyn och samarbeta för verksamhetens bästa. Du förväntas bidra med ditt perspektiv och din kompetens samt vara öppen för andras. Du kommer med idéer och nya angreppssätt för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du är inriktad på resultat i ditt agerande och anpassar dig när behov och inriktning ändras.
   

  

****Övrigt****
 Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Befattningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. Du måste vara svensk medborgare.
   

  

 Placering är i Stockholm. Arbetstid är dagtid och tjänsten innefattar beredskap.
   

  

****Är du intresserad?****
 Vill du veta mer om jobbet och vad vi erbjuder, vänligen kontakta sektionschef Tobias Andersson. Du är även välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsspecialist Filip Ristov. Fackliga kontakter är Johan Strokirk för Saco och Jan Wahlström för ST. Du når dem via Regeringskansliets växel, 08-405 10 00.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast 23 oktober 2026.**
 Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.
   

  

 Regeringskansliets uppdrag är att stödja regeringen i dess arbete med att styra Sverige och förverkliga sin politik. Här arbetar 4 800 personer, varav 600 utomlands. Regeringskansliet välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi ser jämställdhet och mångfald som en styrka och tillgång och vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering. Förvaltningsavdelningen ansvarar för myndighetsövergripande frågor som förändrings- och förnyelsearbete, ekonomi, arbetsgivarfrågor, kompetensförsörjning, kommunikation, säkerhet, it, bibliotek, arkiv och registratur samt för den gemensamma servicen i Regeringskansliet.

title: Student Worker – Turning Bid Archives into a Service Pipeline
description:
**About The Role**
 Siemens is a global technology leader shaping the future of electrification, automation, and digitalization. Within Smart Infrastructure, we are driving the transformation of digital sales to create modern, data-driven customer experiences.
   

  

 Are you passionate about practical AI and automation? We are now looking for a hands-on and curious student to join our Digital Sales team. You will build an extraction pipeline, resolve entity inconsistencies, and connect this data with service records. Your goal is to turn a dusty document archive from our installed base into an actionable service and retrofit pipeline that our Customer Service team will actually use.
   

  

 This is not a research position - you will be building real solutions used by our sales team. This is a real data engineering, extraction and analysis work.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Build Extraction Pipelines: Extract structured data (customer, site, equipment, configuration, dates) from historical PDFs, handling template drift and scanned documents.
* Model the Data: Design the data schema alongside the team to support a unified view of our installed base.
* Resolve Entities & Clean Data: Tackle messy duplicates—matching customer sites across different names, spellings, and systems.
* Score Opportunities: Build logic to identify equipment approaching end-of-life and rank commercial service opportunities.
* Deliver Usable Dashboards: Build practical Power BI dashboards for the Customer Service team.


**What You Will Learn**
* How AI and automation are applied in modern B2B digital sales
* Hands-on experience building real AI agents used in business workflows
* End-to-end sales processes and customer journeys
* Exposure to electrification and automation solutions in the energy domain


**Who are you?**
* Student in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or similar (1 to 2 years remaining)
* You enjoy taking a vague business problem and turning it into something that runs
* Hands-on experience developing AI agents, chatbots, or automation workflows (not just theoretical)
* Comfortable in iterating, prototyping, and quickly turning ideas into working demos
* Structured, proactive, and self-driven
* Swedish and English are must, additional language is a plus


**Technical Skills We Are Looking For**
* Strong SQL skills: Comfortable with complex joins, window functions, and multi-table queries without a tutorial.
* Python data stack: Solid experience with pandas and PDF extraction tools (PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, or OCR).
* Data mindset: You enjoy cleaning messy data, designing schemas, and ensuring accuracy.


**Bonus if you:**
* Experience using LLMs for unstructured document extraction (and knowing where they fail).
* Exposure to entity resolution / fuzzy matching techniques.
* Familiarity with Power BI
* Interest in industrial maintenance, equipment lifecycles, or commercial operations.


**What We Offer**
* A unique opportunity to build real AI solutions in a business context
* High level of ownership and the chance to turn ideas into production concepts
* Flexible working hours to combine work with your studies (approx.. 2 days a week)
* A modern, innovative, and collaborative environment
* Office in Solna
* Strong learning and growth opportunities within Siemens


**Join us**
 Be part of a global technology leader that empowers customers to accelerate their digital and sustainable transformation. At Siemens, you will work in an innovative environment where your ideas, curiosity, and ambition are valued from day one.
   

  

**Ready to Join Us?**
 We're looking for someone to start as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 Application deadline: October 28th
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, background checks are conducted on the final candidate.

description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL**
**You?** 
 A data engineer with around 2-4 years of experience (indicative). Empathetic with the people you collaborate with, proactive about data quality, and creative in how you model solutions. You combine a solid technical foundation with curiosity and care deeply about making sure our data products are reliable, well-governed, and easy to consume.
   

  

**Role?** 
 Data Engineer joining CAM Classifieds & Transactions, responsible for designing, building, and evolving core analytical data products across our Classifieds and Transactions domains that underpin analytics, insights, and AI-driven workflows at Vend.
   

  

**Tech stack?** 
 Snowflake, SQL, dbt, Python.
   

  

**Company?** 
 Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen. Around 500 developers deploy code and models to production thousands of times a week. Our mission is simple:
 *Smart choices made easy* 
 . We connect millions of people across the Nordics while making sustainable living effortless.
   

  

**Location?** 
 Join us in our
 **Oslo** 
 or
 **Stockholm** 
 office, with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely!
   

  

**Why us?** 
 Most data teams are still figuring out how to combine dbt modeling with modern AI agents. With CAM, we are building the shared analytical foundation for all of Vend, using AI-augmented dev workflows to reduce friction and power the flow connecting data, insights, and products. You will join a supportive team where you get to shape these modern practices as we grow.
   

  

*Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!*
**WHO ARE YOU?**
* Collaborative & Empathetic: You communicate clearly across distributed teams in fluent English, bring a supportive attitude to complex problems, and enjoy exploring solutions together.
* Continuous Learner: You take ownership of your professional growth, actively seek feedback, and look for opportunities to develop your technical skills.
* Hands-on with AI Tooling: You are curious about or already use modern dev tools (such as Claude Code, Copilot, or other LLM harnesses) in your daily dev cycles to accelerate code generation, refactoring, and metadata propagation.
* Data & Architectural Fundamentals: You understand layered data modeling, care about quality guardrails, consistent business logic, and modular schema design that scales across marketplace domains.
* Analytics Engineering Skills: You bring solid SQL skills and data modeling concepts, with practical experience or exposure (indicative 1–3+ years) to cloud data platforms (preferably Snowflake) and transformation frameworks (dbt strongly preferred; Python as a plus).
* Authentic Perspective: You bring open dialogue, constructive curiosity, and fresh ideas that help us continuously improve how we work.


**WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?**
**Day-to-day Work & Focus**
 As a Data Engineer In CAM Classifieds & Transactions, You Will Help Build And Evolve Core Data Products That Power Critical Business Decisions And User Experiences Enterprise-wide
   

  

* We used to automate data transformations with manual pipeline setup. Now, we augment our engineering with reasoning and metadata-driven dbt workflows.
* You will work closely with peer engineers across Core Insight & Analytics, as well as analysts, product managers, and software engineers across Vend.
* With active support, mentorship, and guidance from senior engineers, you will contribute directly to our modern dbt and Snowflake architecture.
* Our team consists of 7 members including team lead and lead data engineer. We are an inclusive, collaborative team spread across the Nordics, and we meet up in person several times a year to work, play games, and have fun together!


**What does success look like?**
* After 6 months: You feel confident and supported in building and maintaining dbt models on Snowflake, collaborating smoothly across neighboring teams, and utilizing AI dev tools like Claude Code in your daily workflow.
* After 1 year: You independently handle domain modeling tasks within Classifieds & Transactions, contribute meaningfully to our, and actively share ideas for process and quality improvements.


**The Road Ahead & Technology Evolution**
 We are moving from Matillion to a declarative, metadata-driven and AI-augmented dbt Cloud setup, and we plan to finish in 2027. Our ways of working will change with it. We expect this to make data much easier to access, and to let more people create data transformations and data products themselves. You will work alongside experienced engineers across to build the next-generation data stack, including data contracts, semantic models and automated engineering workflows.
   

  

**A few words from Kristin Hybertsen, Head of CAM Classifieds & Transactions**
*"Hi, I am Kristin! The CAM teams are responsible for providing the shared analytical foundation for all of Vend. We sit inside Core Insight & Analytics alongside Analysts and Data Management, working in close sync with our sister teams in User & Behaviour and Finance & Operations. We build the data products that power insights and decision-making across our marketplaces. We are an inclusive, collaborative, distributed team, valuing open communication, mutual support, and technical curiosity. In our team, we aim to* 
***Unite***
*by building trust while challenging constructively,* 
***Dare***
*by questioning established patterns when there is a better way forward, and* 
***Deliver***
*by ensuring the data products we build are reliable, governed, and trusted. If this sounds like the direction you are looking for, we'd love to welcome you to the team in Oslo, or Stockholm!"*
 Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!
   

  

**GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!**
 Make sure to apply by
 **November 1st, 2026** 
 . We appreciate and encourage earlier applications.

title: Senior Consultant Identity Access Management
description:
**About Us**
 Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by seven Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.
   

  

 With over 780 employees, including more than 585 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.
   

  

 At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Consultant - Identity Access Management to design, implement, integrate, support and optimise enterprise identity solutions for clients. This is a hands-on technical consulting role for an experienced IAM practitioner who can take ownership across the delivery lifecycle while working directly with client stakeholders and internal delivery teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring approximately 5 years of relevant IAM implementation, support or technical consulting experience, with strong hands-on expertise in at least one of SailPoint, Saviynt or Okta. Expertise across all three platforms is not required. The emphasis is on technical implementation capability, sound identity security fundamentals, troubleshooting, documentation and successful client delivery.
   

  

 Responsibilities Include
   

  

* Lead and contribute to the design, configuration, integration, deployment and ongoing support of enterprise IAM solutions.
* Deliver hands-on implementations using at least one of SailPoint, Saviynt or Okta, aligned to client requirements and approved technical designs.
* Gathering and analyising business requirements, translating them into technical requirements, solution designs, configurations and implementation documentation.
* Implement and support Joiner, Mover and Leaver processes, provisioning, deprovisioning, account correlation and reconciliation.
* Configure and support roles, entitlements, access policies, requests, approvals, certifications and access reviews where supported by the selected platform.
* Build and maintain integrations with directories, HR systems, applications, databases and APIs using platform connectors and standard integration methods.
* For Okta engagements, configure and support application integrations, lifecycle management and provisioning, authentication and access policies, SSO/MFA, APIs, SCIM and Okta Workflows where required.
* Troubleshoot provisioning, authentication, workflow, connector and integration issues, and support upgrades, maintenance, health checks and optimisation activities where applicable.
* Plan and support system, integration and user acceptance testing, including defect investigation and resolution.
* Produce technical documentation such as solution designs, configuration documents, runbooks, SOPs and implementation records.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to client stakeholders and internal teams, and manage expectations throughout delivery.
* Contribute to project planning, estimates, delivery tracking, status reporting and risk or issue management.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to technical knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Right to work
   

  

 Candidates must have the existing legal right to work in the country where this position is based. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.
   

  

**Essential**
* Approximately 5 years of relevant professional experience in IAM, enterprise identity implementation/support, systems integration or technical consulting.
* Strong hands-on implementation and support experience in at least one of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud/IdentityIQ, Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud, or Okta.
* Practical understanding of identity lifecycle management, provisioning/deprovisioning, JML, access governance and RBAC.
* Experience integrating identity platforms with Active Directory/LDAP, cloud directories, HR systems, databases and REST/SOAP APIs.

title: IT-förvaltningsresurs till Informationsteknik
description:
***Vill du ha en bred och varierad roll där du får kombinera IT, systemförvaltning och support? Trivs du med att hjälpa andra, lösa problem och samtidigt utvecklas inom flera olika områden?***




***Vi på Informationsteknik söker nu en ny kollega som vill vara en flexibel resurs och bidra där behovet är som störst.***




  
   

  





****Vårt anställningserbjudande****




 Hos oss arbetar vi brett inom både IT och systemförvaltning. Rollen passar dig som har ett stort intresse för IT och som tycker om att arbeta varierat. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – det viktigaste är att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och har ambitionen att lära dig nya områden!
   

  





 Vi arbetar tillsammans, delar kunskap och hjälps åt för att hitta lösningar. Vi söker framför allt en person som är erfaren, nyfiken, flexibel och lösningsorienterad och som vill bidra där verksamhetens behov är som störst.
   

  





 Som anställd på Danderyds sjukhus får du ersättning för sjukvård, ett friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr per år och tillgång till det välutrustade personalgymmet Lyftet för endast 800 kr per år. Du erbjuds även personalparkering till förmånligt pris och subventionerad SL-biljett. Vi har förmånliga ersättningar för dig som är föräldraledig. Utöver det finns pension, semester, företagshälsovård, försäkringar och löneväxling.
   

  





 Allt om dina förmåner
   

  





  
   

  





****Arbetsbeskrivning****




 Du kommer ge stöd till verksamheten i olika IT-relaterade frågor i stort som smått.
   

  





 Det här är en mycket varierande roll med möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera delar av IT och systemförvaltning. Du får också möjlighet att vara delaktig i förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete, till exempel i uppgifter kopplat till kommande journalsystem.
   

  





 Arbetet innebär att du kommer få en central och viktig roll med stor möjlighet att påverkan, utveckla och förbättra verksamhetskritiska IT-tjänster. Du får samarbeta med engagerade kollegor och verksamheter i en varierad vardag med både teknik och verksamhetsutveckling i fokus.
   

  





**I rollen kan du till exempel komma att arbeta med:** 



* Systemförvaltning och användarstöd inom exempelvis TakeCare och Orbit
* Support och problemlösning i vårdsystem.
* Behörighetsadministration och tilldelning av behörigheter
* Samordning och kontakt med olika funktioner inom verksamheten
* Dokumentation, rutiner och förbättring av arbetssätt
* Vara delaktig i utveckling, förberedelser och införande av kommande journalsystem



 Samt övrigt förekommande IT- och förvaltningsrelaterade uppgifter utifrån verksamhetens behov
   

  





 Rollen är flexibel och arbetsuppgifterna kan variera över tid.
   

  





 Tillsammans gör vi skillnad – för vården och patienterna.
   

  





  
   

  





****Kvalifikationer****




 Vi ser gärna att du är en person som tycker om att ta ansvar och som har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system och arbetsområden. Du har vilja och ambition att utvecklas inom nya system och arbetsområden och är intresserad av att bidra i utvecklingen och införandet av kommande journalsystem.
   

  





**Vi söker dig som:** 



* Har minst 5 års erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter inom IT och systemförvaltning,
* Har arbetat med support och problemlösning i vårdsystem eller motsvarande
* Har god förståelse för IT-system och digitala arbetssätt
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemförvaltning och användarstöd
* Är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och självgående
* Trivs med att hjälpa och stötta verksamheter
* Har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika yrkesgrupper
* Är flexibel och kan prioritera utifrån verksamhetens behov



  
   

  





**Meriterande**




 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
 


* TakeCare Orbit
* Behörighetsadministration
* IT-samordning
* Systemförvaltning inom hälso- och sjukvård
* Förändrings- och införandearbete av nya IT-system eller journalsystem



  
   

  





 Låter det som något för dig? 
   

  





 Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningstiden, så varmt välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!
   

  





  

 Vid rekrytering av medarbetare till verksamhet som kan komma att hantera barn och/eller ungdomar upp till 18 år tar vi utdrag ur belastnings- och misstankeregistret inför eventuell anställning.
   

  





**Om Danderyds sjukhus**




  

 Danderyds sjukhus är ett av Sveriges största akutsjukhus med natur, vatten och t-bana runt knuten. Hos oss arbetar omkring 4700 medarbetare och vi tar emot 2000 studenter varje år. Här möts akutsjukvårdens puls med högkvalitativ vård och det nära omhändertagandet. Vi hjälper varandra och ger dig möjligheten att växa och utvecklas från student till erfaren medarbetare. Du som värnar patienten och du som vill driva patientnära forskning kommer att trivas här. Danderyds sjukhus har en egen institution vid Karolinska Institutet vilket innebär ett omfattande uppdrag inom klinisk forskning och grundutbildning. Detta uppdrag är starkt integrerat med den kliniska verksamheten och sjukhusets utveckling.
   

  





  

 Danderyds sjukhus en förvaltning inom Akutsjukhusnämnden i Region Stockholm.
   

  





 Här kan du läsa mer om Danderyds sjukhus
   

  





**Om verksamheten**




  

 Verksamhetsområdet Teknik, Utveckling, Fastighet och Försörjning upprätthåller och utvecklar ändamålsenlig och säker teknik, digitala lösningar och hållbar infrastruktur och försörjning. Inom Teknik, Utveckling, Fastighet och Försörjning återfinns sektionerna Logistik & Service samt Utveckling, Innovation & Teknik.

 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.

description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**

  

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our mission to life every day: enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources they need to achieve their career goals while developing solutions to some of the world’s toughest challenges, from protecting the environment and keeping food safe to helping find cures for cancer.

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

  

Join our AI & Advanced Analytics team as an **AI/ML Development Engineer**, focusing on knowledge graph and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems built on biological data.


Together with the team, you will apply advanced analytics, machine learning and AI to support proteomics discoveries across our R&D organization. You’ll help develop and deploy AI solutions that contribute to novel products, improve operational efficiency and support better decision-making.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

  

You will develop AI and graph-based capabilities in partnership with scientists and software engineers. You’ll help turn research needs into practical RAG systems and production solutions, while supporting adoption of our AI platform and graph data structures.

 **Key responsibilities include**

* Build next-generation graph databases to support AI applications and productivity, including biomedical agents, protein folding and antibody affinity, and next-generation sequencing analysis.
* Gather requirements from scientists who need RAG-augmented systems.
* Develop proof of concepts for RAG systems and bring them into production in collaboration with software engineers.
* Promote and monitor the use of our AI platform and graph data structures.
* Partner with R&D scientists to identify requirements and develop features for production systems.

**How will you get here?**
--------------------------


You are a strong problem solver with attention to detail and a value-driven approach to your work. You communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and are motivated to improve efficiency and optimize development and delivery.

**We are looking for someone who has**
--------------------------------------

* At least three years of industry experience in software engineering, artificial intelligence, data engineering, computational biology or machine learning.

* Strong programming experience with languages and frameworks such as Python, C++, Rust, Cypher, SPARQL and SQL.
* Experience developing and running large language models (LLMs) and creating enterprise RAG solutions.
* Experience with production workloads on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience using Jira and GitHub.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

 **The following experience is considered an advantage**

* Familiarity with big data technologies such as Spark or Databricks.
* A background in proteomics.
* Knowledge of Databricks.

------------


This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. Office work is required three days per week.

title: PhD Student in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography, focus on aerosol-cloud-climate interactions
description:
**Meteorologiska institutionen** vid Stockholms universitet (MISU) bedriver forskning och utbildning som rör atmosfären, oceanen, och fysikaliskt-baserad klimatvetenskap. MISU erbjuder utbildningsprogram på kandidat-, master- och forskarnivå. Vår forskning söker svar på grundläggande frågor om atmosfärens och havens dynamiska, fysiska, kemiska, och biogeokemiska egenskaper av relevans för väder och klimat. Vi strävar efter en bred forskningsverksamhet inom vårt vetenskapliga område.


Vi studerar frågor som sträcker sig från djuphavet till den övre atmosfären och från tropikerna till polerna. I vår forskning utnyttjar och utvecklar vi teori, statistiska metoder och numeriska modeller i nära samspel med observationer. Dessutom utvecklar och leder institutionen observationsbaserad forskning med stöd av satelliter, arktiska isbrytarexpeditioner och landbaserade instrument.


MISU har cirka 60 anställda och ingår i en större forskningsmiljö som inkluderar Bolincentret för klimatforskning, Östersjöcentrum och Swedish e-Science Research Centre. Institutionen har stark internationell prägel, över hälften av medarbetarna har en bakgrund utanför Sverige och både svenska och engelska används som arbetsspråk. Vi välkomnar och värdesätter mångfald i vår arbetsmiljö.  

  

Mer information om oss finns att läsa på: Meteorologiska institutionen.

**Projektbeskrivning**
----------------------


Samspelet mellan aerosolpartiklar och moln utgör en potentiellt betydande, men fortfarande mycket osäker, faktor i klimatförändringarna. Projektet syftar till att öka förståelsen för hur aerosolföroreningar påverkar moln som består av vattendroppar.


Inom projektet ges möjlighet att undersöka detta genom att testa en ny teori som förutspår att aerosolföroreningar förstärker uppvindarna i konvektiva moln, vilket kan göra molnen tjockare och mer reflekterande. Det finns även möjlighet att studera trender i jordens strålningsbudget kopplade till aerosol-moln-interaktioner under satelliteran.


Forskningsarbetet kan omfatta både numeriska simuleringar och analys av satellitdata.

**Behörighetskrav**
-------------------


För att bli antagen till forskarutbildning krävs att den sökande har grundläggande och särskild behörighet. Behörigheten ska vara uppfylld senast sista ansökningsdag.

**Grundläggande behörighet** har du, om du avlagt examen på avancerad nivå, eller fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng (hp), varav minst 60 hp på avancerad nivå, eller på annat sätt inom eller utom landet förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.


För **särskild behörighet** krävs minst 90 hp i något av ämnena meteorologi, oceanografi, fysik eller kemi, minst 15 hp i matematik och ett självständigt arbete om minst 15 hp. Av detta skall minst 60 hp vara på avancerad nivå. Vidare krävs språkkunskaper i engelska motsvarande engelska B på gymnasiet.


Allmän studieplan för studier på forskarnivå i atmosfärsvetenskap och oceanografi.

**Urval**
---------


Urval bland de sökande som uppfyller behörighetskraven ska göras med hänsyn till deras förmåga att tillgodogöra sig utbildningen. Enbart det förhållandet att en sökande bedöms kunna få tidigare utbildning eller yrkesverksamhet tillgodoräknad för utbildningen får inte vid urval ge sökanden företräde framför andra sökande. Beslut om antagning fattas enligt gällande delegationsordning.


Vid bedömningen tas hänsyn till förtrogenhet och skicklighet inom ämnet, förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på engelska, analytisk förmåga, kreativitet, initiativförmåga och självständighet, och samarbetsförmåga. Till grund för bedömningen ligger tidigare studiers relevans, betyg på genomgångna högskolekurser (särskilt de på avancerad nivå), kvalitet och omfattning på det självständiga arbetet, referenser, intervjuer samt skriftlig avsiktsförklaring.


Antagningsordning för utbildning på forskarnivå vid Stockholms universitet.

**Om anställningen**
--------------------


Tillträde den 1 januari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse. Vi erbjuder en tidsbegränsad anställning som doktorand enligt 5 kap. högskoleförordningen (1993:100). Anställningstiden får inte vara längre än vad som motsvarar utbildning på forskarnivå på heltid under fyra år. Som doktorand ska du främst ägna dig åt din egen utbildning på forskarnivå, men i anställningen kan arbete med utbildning, forskning och administration ingå i begränsad omfattning (högst 20 %).


En ny anställning som doktorand gäller för högst ett år, anställningen förnyas därefter med högst två år i taget.

title: PhD student in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography, focus on mixed-phase cloud processes
description:
**The Department of Meteorology** at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain.


We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic.


The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment.  

  

Read more about us here: the Department of Meteorology.

**Project description**
-----------------------


Clouds regulate how much sunlight reaches the Earth’s surface and how much thermal radiation escapes to space, which ultimately influences how hot or cold the planet is. How much each cloud cools or warms the Earth depends in part on its composition. Is it made up of liquid particles, ice particles, or both? How densely spaced and how large are these particles? The answers to these questions lie partially in the dynamics occurring within the cloud. Even clouds that look calm from the ground may generate motions strong enough to shake an airplane. These motions can form new cloud particles and combine or shatter existing ones. However, these motions are difficult to represent completely in computer models of the atmosphere and in laboratory experiments, and we have yet to understand their full impact.  

  

The PhD student will build this understanding using over 800 hours of wind and cloud particle measurements that have been recorded by specialized research aircraft during field campaigns run by government agencies in the US and Europe. Data have been collected over the midwestern US and the Caribbean, off the northwestern coast of Africa, between Australia and Antarctica, and in the vicinity of Svalbard. Quality-controlled versions of all data are already available, so analysis can begin at the project start.The PhD student will develop a detailed understanding of aircraft instrumentation through literature review and apply that expertise to the analysis of measurements from dozens of different aircraft-mounted instruments. All analysis will be done in Python.  

  

The scientific scope initially spans micrometer-scale cloud particles to the dynamical processes that affect clouds, including turbulent eddies and kilometer-scale atmospheric waves. Initial science questions are well defined and focus on identifying statistical relationships between cloud particle properties and cloud-scale dynamics, and investigating how these vary across cloud types and geographic regions.  

  

After the initial stage, the project is more open-ended. The PhD student may choose to focus on the same micrometer–kilometer scales, or to make connections between these scales and the regional or global climate. They may also choose to branch into atmospheric modelling and/or to use machine learning to model observed relationships between cloud dynamics and cloud particles.

**Qualification requirements**
------------------------------


In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be met by the deadline for applications.


You meet **general entry requirements** if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere.


The **specific entry requirements** comprise a minimum of 90 higher education credits in one of the subjects meteorology, oceanography, physics or chemistry, at least 15 higher education credits in mathematics, as well as an independent degree project of at least 15 higher education credits. Furthermore, English language proficiency equivalent to English 6/English Level 2 at upper secondary school is required. The specific entry requirements may also be met by those who have acquired equivalent knowledge through other means, either in Sweden or abroad.  

  

General syllabus for doctoral studies in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography.

**Selection**
-------------


Selection from among applicants who meet the entry requirements shall be made with regards to their ability to benefit from the programme. That fact alone that an applicant is assessed to be able to receive credits for previous educational or professional/vocational activities to be credited to the educational programme may not give the applicant priority over other applicants in the selection process. Decisions on admission are made in accordance with the applicable delegation regulations.


The assessment criteria for admission to the postgraduate programme in atmospheric sciences and oceanography are familiarity with the theory and applications of the subject, subject knowledge relevant to the research project, the ability to express oneself orally and in writing, proficiency in English, analytical ability, creativity, initiative, independence and the ability to work collaboratively. Prior Python experience is desirable but not required. The assessment of the applicant’s ability in these respects are based on the relevance and results of completed higher education courses, the quality and scope of the independent project, references, interviews and a personal statement from the applicant describing their expectations of, and intentions regarding, the programme.


Admission Regulations for Doctoral Studies at Stockholm University.

**About the employment**
------------------------


Starting date is flexible, as per agreement, but preferably not before 1 February 2027. We offer a fixed-term employment as a doctoral student according to Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100). The period of employment may not be longer than what corresponds to full-time doctoral education for four years. As a doctoral student, you should primarily devote yourself to your own doctoral education, but the employment may include work with education, research and administration to a limited extent (maximum 20 %).


A new employment as a doctoral student is for a maximum of one year, the employment is then renewed for a maximum of two years at a time.


Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.

**Contact**
-----------


For more information about the project, please contact Assistant Professor Rachel Atlas, rachel.atlas@misu.su.se.


For more information about the PhD programme, please contact the study director, Associate Professor Thorsten Mauritsen thorsten.mauritsen@misu.su.se.


For information about the recruitment process and terms of employment, please contact Head of Administration Sara Engström, sara.engstrom@misu.su.se.

**Application**
---------------


Apply for the PhD student position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete in accordance with the instructions in the job advertisement, and that it is submitted before the deadline.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Shape the future technology landscape at Tre**  

  

Tre is strengthening its architecture function to support major transformation initiatives across Sweden and Denmark.

As part of this journey, we're looking for a **Technology Architect, Cloud, Compute & Infrastructure** who wants to help shape the future of one of the Nordic region's leading telecom operators.
