title: Enterprise Systems Administrator
description:
**Location**



Our GTM Systems Engineer will be an integral part of our Enterprise Systems team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.


**The Opportunity**  

We're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster.


**Responsibilities**


* Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view.
* Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call.
* Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves.
* Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up.
* Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later.
* Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary.
* Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work.
* Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix.
* Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production.
* Current Sales/Marketing Tech Stack: Salesforce, Dealhub CPQ, Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Gong Professional, Gong Engage, Gong Forecasting, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify, Ringlead


**Qualifications**


* 3+ years hands-on with Salesforce Sales Cloud (advanced Flow, data and security model), plus HubSpot and/or DealHub CPQ.
* Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript.
* A track record of replacing manual processes with automation or self-service, with before-and-after examples.
* Systems thinking: good judgment about where logic and data should live across connected systems.
* Understanding of lead-to-quote-to-close and the marketing funnel (lead lifecycle, attribution).
* Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day.
* Clear communicator who can push back on requests with reasons, and works well with business users and engineers.
* Fluent English, additional languages are a plus.
* Ability to work in the country of residence (we do not provide visa sponsorship).


**Nice to have:**

* Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification;
* Git/SFDX; depth in Gong, ZoomInfo or HubSpot; cloud platform experience;
* experience with an integration platform or event-driven systems.  

  

**Are you a Do'er?**  

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
  

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
  

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.


Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.


**Full-time employee benefits include:**


* Unlimited Vacation
* Flexible Working Options
* Health Insurance
* Parental Leave
* Employee Stock Option Plan
* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program


**Many Do'ers, One Team**  

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: Data center Engineer
description:
About the role We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably. You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability. Key responsibilities Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.
  
  

Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling. Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution. Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management. Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.
  
  

Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities. Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation. Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security. Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.
  
  

Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes. Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required. Required qualifications Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role. Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.
  
  

Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments. Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM. Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics. Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.
  
  

Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors. Professional working proficiency in English. Preferred qualifications Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.
  
  

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools. Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible. Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure. Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.

title: Head of Security
description:
Hej, jag heter Niklas och är CTO på BookBeat, och letar efter dig som kan etablera en ny roll på BookBeat, Head of Security.


Jag tror att du är lite ovanlig, du gillar att hela tiden röra dig mellan att strukturera, organisera, styra och praktiskt implementera säkerhet på riktigt tillsammans med olika team. Det kan handla om allt från legal till kod, itops, plattformar och ai agenter.


Din bakgrund är teknisk, men du är agnostisk kring plattform och teknik och sitter på en djup förståelse för hur säkerhet fungerar på djupet oavsett om det är i en Cloud-plattform eller i en teknisk arkitektur.


Det är viktigt för dig med den mänskliga kontakten och du trivs bäst när du kan bolla idéer, lösa problem och förstå andra team utan ett tangentbord emellan, även om du uppskattar flexibilitet när det behövs. Praktisk säkerhet handlar minst lika mycket om kommunikation och kultur som teknik. Vi kör 4/1 med en valfri remote-dag och vi försöker vara flexibla när livet händer.


Ditt huvudområde kommer vara BookBeats egenutvecklade plattform som alla våra över 1 miljon kunder använder från 30 länder, och allt kring den. Från RBAC till compliance.


Arbetet är väldigt brett, omväxlande och utmanande. I korthet kan man beskriva BookBeats kultur som startup-lik med få inslag av "corporate" även om det till viss del behövs med 170 anställda. Ekonomiskt står vi på egna ben och är lönsamma med Bonnier som ägare.


Jag vill att du är väldigt nyfiken, inte bara på säkerhet och struktur, utan även på hur och varför saker görs. Det kan handla om allt ifrån teknik och domän till människor, team och organisation. Du förstår att det är helheten som spelar roll i slutändan för att nå till säkerhet i praktiken.


Du förstår att man måste vara öppen för nya idéer och dela med sig av sina kunskaper med andra för att både BookBeat och du själv ska kunna utvecklas. Jag tror också du är engagerad i det du gör och i ditt yrke, du bryr dig på riktigt om säkerhet och vilken effekt det ger.


Som Head of Security kommer du rapportera direkt till mig, men jobba självständigt mot många team.


Tillsammans är vårt gemensamma mål på BookBeat att bygga Europas bästa tjänst för att hitta och uppleva digitala böcker.  

  

**Rollen innebär bland annat att:**

* Utveckla och äga BookBeats säkerhetsstrategi och roadmap
* Utbilda
* Kontinuerligt utvärdera säkerheten i plattformen och tillsammans med berörda team genomföra förbättringar
* Göra det enkelt att göra rätt
* Standardisera, dokumentera och förenkla

 **Jag tror att du är grym på:**

* Säkerhet i Cloud-plattformar, särskilt för egenutvecklade tjänster
* Struktur och standardisering
* Svenska och engelska
* AI assisterat arbete
* har relevant universitetsexamen

 **Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**

* Humor
* GDPR
* Kubernetes
* CI/CD
* Olika databaser
* Azure / Entra

 **Som anställd på BookBeat AB erbjuder vi dig:**  

30 dagar betald semester  

️ Arbetstidsförkortning motsvarande en extra ledig dag per år  

ITP1-tjänstepension och möjlighet till flexpension  

Försäkringar, inklusive tjänstegrupplivförsäkring, arbetsskadeförsäkring och tjänstereseförsäkring  

Friskvårdsbidrag, friskvårdstimme och månatliga aktivitetsklubbar  

BookBeat-prenumeration för dig och dina nära  

Arbetsutrustning, inklusive dator, telefon och telefonabonnemang  

Subventionerad möjlighet till företagshälsovård  

Kollektivavtal  

Föräldraledighetsförmåner  

En hållbar balans mellan arbete och fritid, med en arbetsvecka på 37,9 timmar  

Flexibilitet i vardagen, inklusive flexibla arbetstider  

Möjligheter att fortsätta utvecklas genom utmanande arbetsuppgifter, lärande och utbildningsmöjligheter  

Kunskapsdelning inom och mellan team  

Regelbundna frukostar, teamaktiviteter, firanden, roadmap-dagar och andra tillfällen som för oss samman  

Ett centralt beläget huvudkontor i hjärtat av Stockholm, med tillgång till gym, bastu och hundrum  

Rabatter och förmåner via Bonnier, till exempel årlig cykelservice

 **BookBeat i korthet**  

BookBeats resa började 2015, med ambitionen att skapa en marknadsledande tjänst för digitala böcker. Året därpå lanserades vår app.


Idag, runt 10 år efter lanseringen, använder fler än en miljon personer BookBeat varje månad. Vi är en del av Bonnier Books och fortsätter att växa i Europa — men vår resa har bara börjat.


Team BookBeat består idag av runt 170 nyfikna och engagerade "doers", som arbetar inom områden som tech, produktutveckling, böcker, marknadsföring & försäljning, ekonomi, affärsutveckling och people operations.


Det som för oss samman är inte bara vad vi gör, utan hur vi gör det. Våra fyra kärnvärderingar vägleder hur vi arbetar, samarbetar och utvecklas:


Var grym på det du gör  

Dela det du vet och kan  

Nyfikenhet för våra användare och oss  

Bygg Team BookBeat


I praktiken innebär det att vi vill att våra medarbetare fortsätter att utvecklas, samtidigt som de generöst delar med sig av sin kunskap till andra. Vi samarbetar nära mellan team, lär av varandra och är nyfikna på våra användare, vår produkt och resan vi är på. Vi tror också att alla bidrar till kulturen vi bygger tillsammans. Oavsett om det handlar om samarbete, feedback, nya idéer eller att hjälpa en kollega, spelar var och en av oss en roll i att göra BookBeat till en plats där människor kan göra ett riktigt bra jobb och ha kul längs vägen.

title: PhD student in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography, focus on clouds in the atmospheric boundary layer
description:
**The Department of Meteorology** at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain.


We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic.


The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment.  

  

Read more about us here: The Department of Meteorology.

**Project description**
-----------------------


The project focuses on understanding boundary layer cloud processes through Large Eddy Simulation (LES). A novel aspect is to represent cloud microphysics using a Lagrangian technique implemented in the turbulence solver Neko. The successful candidate will contribute to code development work and simulate cloudy marine boundary layers observed in detail over the Baltic Sea.


The project, funded by the Swedish e-science Research Centre, is a collaboration between the Department of Meteorology at Stockholm University, KTH Center for Scientific Computing and KTH Engineering Mechanics.

**Qualification requirements**
------------------------------


In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be met by the deadline for applications.


You meet **general entry requirements** if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere.


The **specific entry requirements** comprise a minimum of 90 higher education credits in one of the subjects meteorology, oceanography, physics or chemistry, at least 15 higher education credits in mathematics, as well as an independent degree project of at least 15 higher education credits. Furthermore, English language proficiency equivalent to English 6/English Level 2 at upper secondary school is required. The specific entry requirements may also be met by those who have acquired equivalent knowledge through other means, either in Sweden or abroad.  

  

General syllabus for doctoral studies in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography.

**Selection**
-------------


Selection from among applicants who meet the entry requirements shall be made with regards to their ability to benefit from the programme. That fact alone that an applicant is assessed to be able to receive credits for previous educational or professional/vocational activities to be credited to the educational programme may not give the applicant priority over other applicants in the selection process. Decisions on admission are made in accordance with the applicable delegation regulations.


The assessment criteria for admission to the postgraduate programme in atmospheric sciences and oceanography are familiarity with the theory and applications of the subject, subject knowledge relevant to the research project, the ability to express oneself orally and in writing, proficiency in English, analytical ability, creativity, initiative, independence and the ability to work collaboratively. The assessment of the applicant’s ability in these respects are based on the relevance and results of completed higher education courses, the quality and scope of the independent project, references, interviews and a personal statement from the applicant describing their expectations of, and intentions regarding, the programme.


Admission Regulations for Doctoral Studies at Stockholm University.

**About the employment**
------------------------


Starting date as per agreement. We offer a fixed-term employment as a doctoral student according to Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100). The period of employment may not be longer than what corresponds to full-time doctoral education for four years. As a doctoral student, you should primarily devote yourself to your own doctoral education, but the employment may include work with education, research and administration to a limited extent (maximum 20 %).


A new employment as a doctoral student is for a maximum of one year, the employment is then renewed for a maximum of two years at a time.


Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.

**Contact**
-----------


For more information about the project, please contact Professor Gunilla Svensson, gunilla.svensson@misu.su.se.


For more information about the PhD programme, please contact the study director, Professor Thorsten Mauritsen thorsten.mauritsen@misu.su.se.


For information about the recruitment process and terms of employment, please contact Head of Administration Sara Engström, sara.engstrom@misu.su.se.

**Application**
---------------


Apply for the PhD student position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete in accordance with the instructions in the job advertisement, and that it is submitted before the deadline.


We kindly ask applicants to refrain from submitting AI-generated applications.


The instructions for applicants are available at: How to apply for a position.

title: Platform Engineer - Customer Zero
description:
Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura! At Coretura we build one software platform for commercial vehicles, and we deliver it as a single product to multiple customers including Volvo and Daimler. It is never finished: every change we make reaches both manufacturers, often several times a week. That kind of tempo is only possible if you can prove a release is solid before it leaves the building.
  
  

That is why we built Customer Zero. What is Customer Zero? Customer Zero is the Coretura canary OEM: a real, production-shaped tenant run as if it were an external customer, with its own identities, its own network, and its own access boundary, outside the internal Coretura network. It is the first real recipient of every release, and the point is simple: find what is broken or rough before Volvo, Daimler, or the next OEM does.
  
  

What you will be doing You own the technical environment that makes Customer Zero credible, not just that it exists, but that it genuinely behaves like the environment of a real customer, by making sure the build environment and development tools work in an OEM context. In practice, that means building and maintaining the infrastructure, keeping the developer portal and development environment operational. Setting up routine validation on every release to make sure that every release is better than the last. You will team up with our Customer Zero Lead and work closely with Quality Release Engineers and own the technical cloud domain of the simulated customer environment.
  
  

Communication is at the heart of the role. Customer Zero sits between teams, so you will spend much of your time sharing what you find, explaining why it matters, and aligning developers and stakeholders around it. You communicate in a way that builds trust and brings people together. What you will be working with: AWS infrastructure provisioning as code with Terraform and Virtual Engineering Workbench Our developer portal, built in Next.js and Bun Docker, GitHub actions, Gerrit, other CI systems Artifactory, ECS, Grafana Playwright, Python or other test frameworks We believe you bring Previous experience developing embedded software Solid experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform on AWS Hands-on experience running container-based workloads with Docker and ECS/Fargate Confidence in GitHub, building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or CI tools.
  
  

Experience from functional safety or cyber security development, such as ISO- 21434, ISO-26262 or ISO 27001, is a plus rather than a requirement. Why this role? The fun part is that nothing written above is set in stone. It will change, it must change, as we learn more and the demands on us grow.
  
  

You are part of that ride. Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles? We review applications on a continuous basis—so don’t wait to submit yours! Last application date: 3rd of November 2026.
  
  

Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position. Please note we do not accept any applications via email. About our recruitment process We are committed to a safe and secure working environment.
  
  

As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation. A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
RaySearch is expanding its machine learning capabilities and is looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join our headquarters in Stockholm. This is an office-first role.


You will help build our model development platform: the systems that take clinical data through curation, training and validation to deployed models. Our deep learning models are used in RayStation, our treatment planning system, at cancer clinics worldwide. The platform you build is how the next generation of these models gets made.


This is not primarily a model development role. Your focus is the platform, data and infrastructure that let ML engineers develop, validate and deploy models reliably.

**About the job**
=================


You will join RaySearch's Machine Learning department and help build a platform that covers the full model lifecycle, from clinical data coming in to validated models going out.

**The work spans:**
-------------------

* Data curation and management: ingesting, organizing and validating large clinical datasets and medical images, with ETL, databases and storage that keep track of where data came from and how it was used.
* Model training: reproducible training pipelines orchestrated with Flyte, for dose prediction, segmentation, detection, classification and image registration, with monitoring of training runs.
* Validation: automated evaluation and reporting that connects data, method, code and results, including web-based tools for reviewing images, contours, radiotherapy plans and validation outcomes.
* Deployment and ML integration: getting models into production and integrated into our software products, including inference optimization.
* Operations: monitoring training and evaluation runs, keeping services and databases up to date, and troubleshooting when things go wrong.
* The platform is used by multiple teams and projects, so good design matters: well-designed APIs, solid documentation and reliable services. You will own services from design to operation and work closely with ML engineers, software developers, infrastructure teams, medical physicists and product teams.

**Your profile**
================


You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys building systems that help others do their best work. You are pragmatic: you know when a simple solution is enough and when the problem needs a more scalable architecture. You care about reliability, automation and developer experience. You like building platforms that are robust and well-designed enough to serve many different users.


You don't need to spend your days training neural networks. You do understand how ML development differs from traditional software engineering, and you find problems like reproducibility, data lineage, model versioning, large datasets and GPU workloads interesting.

**Requirements**
----------------

* M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning or equivalent experience, and at least 5 years of professional software engineering.
* Strong Python skills and experience designing backend services and APIs.
* Solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling, such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience with containers, for example Docker, and with designing, running and troubleshooting production services.
* Good engineering practices: automated testing, code review, CI/CD and observability.
* Experience contributing to architecture decisions in large, shared codebases.
* Excellent spoken and written English.

**Meriting**
------------


Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

* ML platforms and MLOps tooling, such as MLflow and experiment tracking.
* PyTorch, and model deployment or inference optimization, such as TensorRT.
* Workflow orchestration and ETL. We use Flyte, but experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster or similar is just as relevant.
* Kubernetes, cloud platforms and infrastructure as code.
* Designing platforms and APIs used by many teams or users, including access control and security.
* Operating production services with high reliability requirements.
* Web application development.
* Medical imaging (DICOM, RT structures), healthcare technology or other regulated, safety-critical environments.

**Our Culture**
===============


At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.

**Our Offer**
=============


We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

**Application**
===============


Please apply for the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

As reflected in our core values, we care about both People and Results. At Apica, we help each team member grow while everyone delivers results and contributes to the company’s success.


You will be part of an international finance team and report to Apica’s CFO. The role is located in Stockholm, Sweden.

Apica is a leading provider of innovative software solutions in the Observability space, designed to revolutionize how businesses gain insights into their systems and applications. **About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**We’re Salesforce** , the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.
  

Our Enterprise Business team focuses on working with our most strategic customers and organizations of 10,000+ employees. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced team with various customers and receive personalized training and career opportunities.
  

  

**About the role:**  

This is a unique opportunity to join a highly successful team of seasoned Enterprise Account Executives working with the company's Top Accounts. Salesforce is looking for very hardworking, high EQ and passionate individuals who can effectively articulate how & why our solutions can help transform Customers’ business and exceed their goals.
  

Salesforce aspires to deliver business transformation enabled by technology to its customers and therefore requires individuals able to develop deep insight into the business dynamics of large sophisticated enterprises and help shape customers' change agenda.
  

  

**Your Day-to-Day:**

* Our Enterprise Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and c-suite decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.
* You will use your skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.
* Develop key customer stakeholder relationships and drive customer satisfaction at assigned accounts
* Develop and drive the overall long-term strategy for the account, aligned to customer business objectives
* Coordinate internal Salesforce resources to meet customer business needs
* Perform account planning at assigned accounts, coordinating with Prime and Cloud sales resources to ensure strategic alignment
* Share Salesforce value proposition for existing and/or new customers
* Drive growth within an existing assigned account
* Preferred Qualifications:
* 10+ years of full-cycle sales experience in the Swedish market
* Ability to strategize with a large extended team
  

  

**What we look for in you:**

* Effective communicator & quick learner: Ability to articulate how & why our solutions can help transform Customers’ business and exceed their goals.
* Successfully run complex SaaS sales deals: Ability to develop sophisticated deal structures and commercial proposals for large deals.
* Strong analytical & problem-solving skills are essential
* Strong influencing capabilities; must be a self-starter, high-energy
* Strong appetite to work in a strategic selling environment.
* Fluent in English and Swedish + Right to work in Sweden
  

  

**Working at Salesforce**  

Working at Salesforce isn’t all about selling. It’s also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including a week-long product boot camp, mentorship program, weekly coaching and development programs.


Unleash Your Potential


When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

**About the role**  

As our **Technology Architect, Integration, API & Event Platforms**, you will own the enterprise architecture direction for APIs, integrations and event-driven platforms across Sweden and Denmark.



Your scope includes APIs, events, messaging, streaming, integration security, observability and legacy modernisation.



The role combines strategic platform direction with practical guidance for engineering teams. You will define reusable standards and paved roads that make preferred integration approaches easier to adopt while ensuring that exceptions remain visible and manageable.



You will collaborate closely with Domain Architects, Security and IAM teams, platform teams, Solution Architects, Tech Leads and major transformation programmes.

description:
**Are you an experienced network specialist looking to work with some of Sweden’s most complex IT environments? Do you want to combine deep technical expertise with advisory work, solution design, and close customer collaboration? If so, this could be your next career move.**

  

My name is **Solveig Jagelid** , and I lead our fantastic Networking & Hybrid IT team in the Eastern Region. We are now looking for a Senior Network Consultant or Network Architect who wants to help shape the infrastructure solutions of tomorrow for some of our most exciting customers.

  

  

At **Telia Cygate** , you will work alongside some of the industry’s leading specialists in networking, security, and hybrid IT. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, contribute your expertise to complex projects, and continue developing your skills in an environment where knowledge sharing and professional growth are central to our culture.

  

  

If you have experience with **Cisco, Aruba, and/or Fortinet** and are passionate about solving advanced technical challenges, we would love to hear from you.

  

  

  

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

As a **Senior Network Consultant / Network Architect** , you will work across the entire lifecycle, from advisory services and solution design to implementation, automation, and troubleshooting in complex IT environments.

  

  

You will act as a strategic partner to our customers, helping them develop future-proof networking and security solutions. Our projects are often business-critical and span multiple technology domains, giving you the opportunity to collaborate with experts in networking, security, cloud, and hybrid IT.

  

  

With us, you'll work with modern technologies, large-scale environments, and solutions that make a real difference.  

  



  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Advise customers on modern networking and infrastructure solutions.
* Design and architect network and security solutions at both strategic and operational levels.
* Implement, configure, and further develop complex network environments.
* Troubleshoot and optimize business-critical infrastructures.
* Participate in projects involving networking, security, automation, and hybrid IT.
* Build long-term customer relationships and act as a trusted technical advisor to key stakeholders and decision-makers.
  

  

  

**To Succeed in This Role**
---------------------------

We believe you are someone who enjoys technical challenges and thrives in a consultative role where you can combine deep technical expertise with customer engagement.

  

  

You are comfortable taking ownership, driving initiatives forward, and translating business requirements into sustainable technical solutions. At the same time, you enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to the growth and success of the team around you.  

  



  

### **We Are Looking For Someone With**

* Several years of experience working with network infrastructure in large-scale environments.
* Strong expertise in Cisco, Aruba, and/or Fortinet technologies.
* Solid knowledge of routing, switching, and network design.
* Experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex network solutions.
* Fluency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.
  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications within Cisco, Aruba, and/or Fortinet.
* Experience in network security, automation, or hybrid/cloud environments.
* Previous experience working as a consultant and providing technical advisory services.
  

  

  

*Telia is part of critical infrastructure and parts of our operations are subject to security protection. Depending on the role, vetting activities may be required prior to employment. In some cases, additional eligibility requirements, including specific citizenship requirements, may apply.*  



  

***Why Telia Cygate?***  

  



At Telia Cygate, we’re not only experts in networks, security, and various types of cloud solutions – we’re also a team that believes work should be fun! As part of Telia Company, we have the strength to create real impact on a large scale, contribute to societal value, and help our customers navigate the world of digitalization. And we always do it with warmth, care, and a smile.

  

  

Here, it’s our ideas and diverse perspectives that make us strong, and together we ensure that the world of technology becomes a place where everyone feels good – and where you belong.  

  



Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.  

  



Welcome to grow together with us – where we make technology human and create real impact!  

  



**Telia Cygate** **is proud to be** **certificated** **as** **Great** **Place to** **Work!**


With us, people are at the center – here you get the chance to grow, be challenged, and thrive together with dedicated colleagues. We are building a culture where security, togetherness, and opportunities go hand in hand. Do you want to be part of the journey? Welcome to a workplace that truly lives up to its name.  

  



**What we offer**


When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.  

  



**Interested? Apply!**


We look forward to receiving your application by **2026-11-08.**
  

Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!  

  



Location: Solna  

  



If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our **Talent Acquisition Partner.**
  

  

Background and reference checks will be part of the process

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and external vendors not to contact us regarding this position.

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. title: Red Team Lead – AI-Enabled Offensive Security | SEB, Solna
description:
Are you a senior offensive security professional with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or red teaming? Do you want to lead advanced security testing and shape how artificial intelligence is used in modern offensive security?



Join SEB’s Operational Security Center and lead high-impact red and purple team activities that challenge our defenses, strengthen detection and response capabilities, and translate realistic attack scenarios into measurable risk reduction.



**About the Role**



As Red Team Lead, you will lead and further develop SEB’s red team capability. You will combine extensive hands-on offensive security expertise with technical leadership, stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement of methods, tooling, automation, and reporting.



This is a senior, hands-on technical role rather than solely a coordination or management position. You will lead complex engagements while remaining actively involved in security testing, adversary emulation, attack-path analysis, and the development of offensive security tooling.



You will work closely with penetration testers, security engineers, incident responders, threat intelligence specialists, application and platform teams, and external partners.



A key part of the role is to responsibly explore and operationalize AI-assisted offensive security. This includes using AI to accelerate research, analysis, automation, scenario development, security testing, and reporting while maintaining strong human oversight, security controls, and professional judgment.

  



**What you’ll do:**



* Lead red and purple team engagements from planning and scoping through execution, reporting, remediation follow-up, and lessons learned.
* Design realistic, threat-informed attack scenarios across applications, APIs, identities, endpoints, cloud services, infrastructure, and externally exposed assets.
* Perform and guide hands-on offensive security activities, including penetration testing, adversary emulation, exploitation, attack-path analysis, lateral movement, and security control validation.

**You will:**

**To thrive in this role, we believe you have**

**The Team**



You will be part of SEB’s Operational Security Center, working with specialists across penetration testing, security engineering, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and incident response.



Together, we identify realistic attack paths, challenge defensive capabilities, validate security controls, and ensure that technical findings lead to concrete improvements in SEB’s cyber resilience.



The role provides an opportunity to combine deep offensive security expertise with AI, automation, and security engineering in a large and complex technology environment.



**What We Offer**



* A leading role in developing and evolving an advanced red team capability.
* The opportunity to remain technically hands-on while providing technical direction and leadership.

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-10-26. If you have questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Linn Odén at linn.oden@seb.se, note that we will not process applications via email.



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

title: PhD student in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography, focus on ML-methods in climate modelling
description:
**The Department of Meteorology** at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain.


We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic.


The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment.


You can read more about us here: the Department of Meteorology.

**Project description**
-----------------------


Clouds and their responses to varying environmental conditions are particularly important determinants of current climate and future climate change. However, the resolution of a typical climate model is far too coarse to explicitly represent processes of relevance to cloud formation. Those processes therefore need to be parameterized, or represented as functions of large-scale state variables. Such sub-grid scale parameterizations are associated with large uncertainties, and are also computationally expensive.  

  

This project focuses on novel ways to bridge between micro- and global scales, to improve climate model accuracy, efficiency and generalizability, and leverage modern computer architecture. We will explore the use of machine learning (ML) models trained on combinations of observational data and high-resolution simulations, as alternatives to empirical parameterizations of essential, unresolved sub-grid scale processes related to turbulence, cloud formation and aerosol-cloud interaction. The tasks will include deriving and training data-driven models, coupling them to a large-scale climate model, evaluating the results against observations and traditionally parameterized models, and using the ML-enhanced model to estimate climate-relevant quantities like cloud radiative effects and forcing from aerosol-cloud interactions.  

  

The work will be carried out in close collaboration with data scientists within the Swedish e-Science Research Centre, and contribute to development of methods with applicability also beyond climate science. The successful candidate will thereby develop their skills in atmospheric science and climate modelling, but also in data science and machine learning, and in communicating and collaborating within and across disciplines.

**Qualification requirements**
------------------------------


In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be fulfilled before admission to the programme.


You meet **general entry requirements** if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere.


The **specific entry requirements** additionally require a minimum of 90 higher education credits in any of the fields of meteorology, oceanography, physics or chemistry; and at least 15 higher education credits in mathematics as well as a degree project of at least 15 higher education credits. At least 60 higher education credits of these courses must be on the second-cycle level. In addition, proficiency in English language, equivalent to English B in Swedish high school, is required.  

  

The specific entry requirements may also be fulfilled by a person who has otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere.  

  

General syllabus for doctoral studies in atmospheric science and oceanography.

**Selection**
-------------


The selection between candidates who meet the entry requirements will be made with reference to their ability to benefit from the training. However, the fact that an applicant is deemed able to transfer credits from previous training or professional experience may not alone give the applicant priority over other applicants in the selection process. Admission decisions are made in accordance with current delegation policies.


The assessment criteria for admission to the postgraduate programme in atmospheric sciences and oceanography are familiarity with the theory and applications of the subject, subject knowledge relevant to the research project, the ability to express oneself orally and in writing, proficiency in English, analytical ability, creativity, initiative, independence and the ability to work collaboratively. The assessment of the applicant’s ability in these respects are based on the relevance and results of completed higher education courses, the quality and scope of the independent project, references, interviews and a personal statement from the applicant describing their expectations of, and intentions regarding, the programme.


Admission Regulations for Doctoral Studies at Stockholm University.

**About the employment**
------------------------


Starting date as per agreement. We offer a fixed-term employment as a doctoral student according to Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100). The period of employment may not be longer than what corresponds to full-time doctoral education for four years. As a doctoral student, you should primarily devote yourself to your own doctoral education, but the employment may include work with education, research and administration to a limited extent (maximum 20 %).


A new employment as a doctoral student is for a maximum of one year, the employment is then renewed for a maximum of two years at a time.


Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.

**Contact**
-----------


For more information about the project, please contact professor Frida Bender, frida.bender@misu.su.se.


For more information about the PhD programme, please contact the study director, Associate Professor Thorsten Mauritsen thorsten.mauritsen@misu.su.se.


For information about the recruitment process and terms of employment, please contact Head of Administration Sara Engström, sara.engstrom@misu.su.se.

**Application**
---------------


Apply for the PhD student position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete in accordance with the instructions in the job advertisement, and that it is submitted before the deadline.


We kindly ask applicants to refrain from submitting AI-generated applications.


The instructions for applicants are available at: How to apply for a position.


Stockholm University contributes to the development of sustainable democratic society through knowledge, enlightenment and the pursuit of truth.

description:

Du är trygg i att analysera och ifrågasätta kravbilder samt komma med konstruktiva och innovativa förbättringsförslag. Grundläggande utvecklingskompetens och förståelse för systemanpassningar.

Passion for advising customers on their digital transformation and data strategy, with a focus on co-creating innovative solutions that address real business challenges.

Målet är att säkerställa realistiska och uppdaterade tidplaner, tydliggöra beroenden och tidsmässiga risker samt bidra till effektiv projektstyrning genom hela projektlivscykeln. I uppdraget ingår även att stödja juniora tidplanerare och projektingenjörer samt utveckla organisationens metoder och rutiner för tidplanering.

**Arbetsuppgifter**


Ta fram, uppdatera och kvalitetssäkra tidplaner i systemstöd såsom Antura och Primavera.


Samordna tidplaner från flera leverantörer och säkerställa att beroenden och gränssnitt hanteras korrekt.


Planera och följa upp projektens samtliga faser, från analys och planering till genomförande och avslut.


Leda tidplaneringsmöten och samordningsmöten med projektledare, leverantörer och teknikansvariga.


Identifiera och analysera tidsmässiga risker, kritiska linjer, resursbehov och avvikelser samt ta fram beslutsunderlag och rapporter.


Utveckla och förbättra arbetssätt, metoder, mallar och systemstöd för tidplanering i enlighet med organisationens processer och styrande dokument.


Stödja och utbilda juniora tidplanerare och projektingenjörer samt bidra med tidsplaneringskompetens i projektens tidiga skeden.

**Krav (OBS, obligatoriska)**


Du ska ha högskoleutbildning eller YH-utbildning inom relevant område, exempelvis samhällsbyggnad, väg och vatten, lantmäteri, farkostteknik, maskinteknik, elektroteknik eller datateknik.


Du ska ha minst 9 års erfarenhet av tidsplanering eller produktionsplanering i komplexa projekt, exempelvis byggprojekt, infrastrukturprojekt eller systemprojekt.


Du ska ha minst 9 års erfarenhet av tidplanering med hjälp av systemstöd såsom MS Project, Primavera eller likvärdigt inom bygg- eller infrastrukturprojekt.


Du ska ha minst 9 års erfarenhet av att ta fram tidplaner där flera leverantörers tidplaner behöver samordnas för att leverera projektet.


Du ska ha minst 9 års erfarenhet av att planera projektets samtliga faser inom projektlivscykeln: analys, planering, genomförande och avslut.


Du ska ha mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.

**Meriterande**


Minst 4 års erfarenhet av arbete inom offentlig sektor eller på entreprenadsidan.


Minst 4 års erfarenhet av systemstödet Antura eller likvärdiga system såsom Zoho Projects, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Wrike, Microsoft Project eller Adobe Workfront.


Minst 4 års erfarenhet av verksamhetsutveckling kopplad till tidplanering.


**Personliga egenskaper**


Du har ett helhetsperspektiv och förmåga att se samband och beroenden mellan olika delar av projekten.


Du är initiativtagande.


Du är kreativ.


Du är driven.


Du har ett stort intresse för att samarbeta med många olika personer.

**Om oss**


Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt.


Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov.


Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerad personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet.


För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst.


Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se.

**Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska.**


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

**Job Summary:**


We are seeking an **AI Platform Engineer** to design and build a next-generation cloud platform for Alarm Intelligence. The role combines cloud architecture, machine learning infrastructure, data engineering, and software engineering to enable scalable AI services across multiple countries and large volumes of security events. The role is highly hands-on, requiring both architectural leadership and strong software engineering expertise to support AI model training, real-time inference, data processing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

* Experience with Computer Vision, Edge AI, IoT, or Embedded AI.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
**Cloud Security Engineer**  

Sweden, Denmark or Norway

 **Puzzel: The Low-Down**

Puzzel is a leading provider of cloud-based contact centre solutions, empowering businesses to deliver exceptional customer service. Our platform combines omnichannel contact centre, workforce management, and AI-driven analytics to optimize customer interactions and operational efficiency.


With 25 years’ experience since our foundation in Norway, we’re already #1 in the Nordics; growing rapidly in the UK and we are already seeing some great success in the Netherlands since opening the entity in mid-2024, but our ambition is to become the clear European market-leader in the coming years


**Why we’re proud**

* Recognised as an Innovation and Growth Leader in the 2025 EMEA Customer Experience Platforms Frost Radar
* 2024 CX Awards Winner, ‘Best Mid-Market Contact Center Platform’
* Puzzel was recognised as the 'most innovative European-founded CCaaS provider' and top 3 globally by Frost & Sullivan in 2023
* Best Practices Company of the Year 2023
* Consistently high Glassdoor rating
* Puzzel places high importance on work-life balance and flexible working hours - as recognised by Flexa, placing 16th overall for work:life balance in 2025!
* We are working with Mercer on salary benchmarking, to ensure pay equality and market competitiveness


Read more about us *here*.

**What you'll do**

Puzzel is investing in its security function. This role owns the security of our public cloud (Azure and AWS) and private data centre estate, and owns infrastructure vulnerability management across the company. This role focuses on designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving security controls that protect our product. This role reports to the CISO.

**What you will own**

* The security of our public cloud (Azure and AWS) and private data centre estate: network segmentation, firewall policy, system hardening and patching.
* Infrastructure vulnerability management end to end — scope, triage, remediation tracking and closure. Tenable is one of the tools you will use; owning the outcome matters more than owning the tool.
* Threat modelling and secure design input for infrastructure change, offered as support rather than imposed as a gate.

**What you must be able to do**


The following capabilities are essential in this role, and we will explore all at interview.

* Threat hunting
* Threat modelling
* Vulnerability management
* Networking


We are looking for judgement, not tool administration. Running a scanner is the easy part of this job.

**The must haves**

* Hands-on infrastructure security in private data centre environment
* Hands-on cloud security experience in Azure, AWS or both
* Deep network security expertise: Firewall, VLANs, segmentation, WAF, TLS/mTLS, VPN, workload and configuration security, and system hardening.
* Virtualisation platforms - VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix or similar.
* Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration.
* Application security testing and OWASP or similar frameworks.
* SOC and SIEM or any infrastructure security monitoring platforms.
* Cloud security posture management tooling.
* Vulnerability scanning tools, SAST, DAST and SCA (including, Tenable, Snyk or similar tools).
* Experience turning scanner and dependency findings into prioritized, tracked and closed work.

**The nice to haves**

* Terraform, Bicep or similar tools for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Proficiency in programming languages, such as, .NET, Python, Ruby.
* An offensive security mindset; penetration testing or red team experience is a strong advantage.
* AI / Agentic security.
* Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2 or DORA.
* Experience in SaaS, or in a regulated environment.
* Certifications such as OSCP or CREST, CISSP or CCSP, and vendor credentials in VMware, Nutanix or Cisco, or Azure or AWS, are welcome but not required.


Even it fulfill only some of the requirements, and you are still interested, we would like to hear from you.

**The location**


This role can be located in our offices in Sweden, Denmark or Norway, with expectation of 2-3 days/week in the office.

**What’s In it for You?**

* Competitive salary based on Mercer salary benchmarking data
* Flexible, hybrid approach to working; split your time between the office and home
* You get to be part of a fun, driven and supportive team
* Annual Summer and Christmas parties
* Excellent development opportunities and a great company culture

**What to expect from the interview process**

* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* 1st interview with Hiring Manager - CISO
* 2nd interview with Product & Technology Lead
* Final interview with Chief Technology Officer

**Puzzel Values**

* **Built on Trust –** trust is an intrinsic Nordic value, upon which Puzzel has been built. We trust each other and our customers and partners trust us.
* **Stronger Together –** working together in a genuinely collaborative way, with a shared purpose, we have an empowered organisation that is better equipped to delight customers and partners.
* **Stay Hungry –** have a continuous hunger to raise our game, innovate and be the best we can be professionally.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We want everyone at Puzzel to be their true, authentic selves at work irrespective of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical ability, age, or economic background.


Whilst we are proud to already have a diverse workforce from across the globe, we are aware that things could always be improved – for example, we currently have a ratio of female 26:74 male employees, which whilst not uncommon for the tech industry (average in SaaS is 26% female), it’s far from ideal. So, what are we doing to improve this?

* Our C-suite has moved from 100% male in 2023 to a 5:3 male-to-female split today.
* We have increased our % of female hires from 23.6% in 2021 to 38.5% in 2023.
* We are partnering with the likes of Flexa, who have significantly higher-than-average talent pools of candidates from diverse backgrounds.
* We are working with State Employment initiatives in Norway and Sweden to bring candidates through internship/apprenticeship routes and are investigating similar initiatives in the UK and Bulgaria.
* By raising awareness and transparency, we are hoping to further attract a diverse workforce.

  

We are continuously striving to foster an inclusive and diverse environment, where everyone is celebrated for who they are. If there is anything we can do to support you in the interview process, or beyond, please let us know.

**One Last Thing**

Even if you feel you are only a 75% match for this role, we still want to hear from you. This list is purely indicative. Skills can always be learnt.


Please note that we are not able to provide sponsorship for this role, so you must have eligibility to work in the country you are applying for.

*By applying you accept the terms of our Privacy Notice which can be found on our website. Puzzel are not considering candidates that do not have a work permit in the country we are hiring in.*

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, AWS Region Services
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Would you thrive at helping customers implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve deep technical problems? Would you like to deliver and refine modern cloud computing technologies, as part of a global team? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems and delivering the next generation of cloud computing in Sweden, including offerings like S3, EC2, CloudFront and SageMaker.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders through structured communications, operational reviews, and clear reporting on outcomes and business impact
* Work with engineers, developers, program and product managers to coordinate the launch of different services into special regions.
* Develop and manage comprehensive program roadmaps spanning multiple AWS workstreams.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and high-risk areas, and deliver against these in partnership with service and operations teams.
* Produce and evaluate launch, resource, and compliance metrics.
* Work with AWS service owners around the world to develop innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.
* Manage the build and deployment of new tooling to streamline and automate security, testing, and region launch related initiatives.

  

A day in the life  

As Senior Technical Program Manager for our team, you will be responsible for planning, delivery and ongoing development of a strategic new AWS region. You will work at the forefront of cloud technologies, with interactions across the full breadth of AWS services. You will coordinate and influence teams across multiple disciplines (product, operations, engineering, leadership) and translate global strategy into local execution.
  

  

In this role, you’ll need to be passionate about delivering services to customers while also possessing a solid understanding of business needs. You will need a strong technical background, enabling you to produce concrete specifications and work closely with engineering to drive implementation. As part of our team, you’ll need a track record of operating independently with strong judgment, and you'll need to be to be creative and proactive in developing solutions.  

  

About the team  

Here at AWS, we hold high standards for the services we deliver to our customers: Our services are highly secure, highly reliable and highly available, and function at massive scale. Our diverse team is smart, passionate about the cloud, dedicated to serving customers, fun to work with, and dedicated to supporting new members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We also put a high value on work-life balance, because striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Math ("STEM" majors) or equivalent experience (Computer Science preferred)
* 10+ years of technical program management experience with strong technical background and ability to understand complex architectures and AI technologies
* 12+ years' experience in enterprise IT, software development, or technical consulting
* Experience managing programs involving Generative AI, Agentic AI, or emerging AI technologies with measurable outcomes
* Experience owning and driving roadmap strategy for technical programs, representing and advocating for customers during executive-level prioritization and planning
* Superior written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated experience engaging at executive levels across multiple organizations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Technical background with understanding of software development practices and ability to contribute to engineering discussions around architecture and technology decisions
* Direct experience implementing AWS services across compute, storage, analytics, or modern application architectures
* Understanding of Generative AI solution patterns including RAG, fine-tuning, model evaluation, and agentic AI architectures including multi-agent systems, tool use, and orchestration frameworks
* Experience with Amazon's Working Backwards methodology, Design Thinking frameworks, and writing PR/FAQs
* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and critical path management with experience defining KPIs and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience managing customer-facing technical engagements or professional services delivery
* AWS or other cloud certifications; PMP and/or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certified
* Self-motivated problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments with ability to learn new tools quickly and balance rapid solution delivery with thoughtful architecture decisions

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Product Manager - Data Driven Products
description:
**About Us**
**nShift** 
 is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 500 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.
   

  

 Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!
   

  

 If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.
   

  

**About You**
 You think like a product manager and work like a data scientist. You have shipped ML-powered products to real customers and can point to the decisions you made, not just the ones made around you. Messy data, ambiguous model outputs, and stakeholders who don't yet see why the data matters are familiar territory.
   

  

 You think in terms of compounding: how every data point collected today improves predictions tomorrow, and how that improvement builds a position competitors cannot close. Data insights is nShift's path from a tool company to an intelligence platform, and that scope motivates you rather than overwhelming you.
   

  

 You are as comfortable in a Jupyter notebook as in a leadership meeting, and you know when each is needed.
   

  

**Purpose of role**
 The mission is to define what nShift builds with that data, validate it before engineering commits, and ship intelligence products that help shippers make better decisions. A shipper asking "how can I improve my delivery experience" should get an answer powered by the full network, not just their own history. Done well, that becomes a compounding intelligence layer: every data point collected today improves suggestions tomorrow, and the improvement creates a position no competitor can close.
   

  

 The intelligence layer draws from two sources. Structured operational data, such as shipment telemetry and carrier performance, feeds statistical models and predictions. Qualitative data, such as customer support interactions, delivery exception messages, and community feedback, carries signal that numbers alone cannot surface. LLMs make that signal extractable and usable at scale. This role owns both.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of product management and data science. You have the technical depth to build ML proof-of-concepts independently and the commercial judgment to translate those capabilities into products customers pay for. You write the strategy and the first notebook.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Define and own the data driven product strategy**
* Own the roadmap for nShift's data intelligence layer: carrier performance prediction, cross-customer benchmarking, ML-driven carrier recommendations, and related capabilities.
* Translate nShift's data asset into a sequenced product strategy that delivers near-term value while building toward the compounding intelligence layer vision.
* Define the information architecture for the data insights layer: what data is collected, how it is normalized (in partnership with adjacent teams), and how it is exposed to upstream products.
* Make hard prioritization calls: what to build first to validate the ML hypothesis, what to defer, and what to kill when the data doesn't support the bet.
* Own the qualitative intelligence pipeline alongside the quantitative one: define which unstructured sources carry decision-relevant signal (support tickets, delivery exception messages, customer forum, carrier communications), how LLM-extracted insights are structured for downstream use, and how qualitative and quantitative signals combine into a coherent intelligence product.
* Own the positioning and differentiation narrative: why this dataset is uniquely nShift's, why no competitor can replicate it, and how to articulate that defensibility to enterprise buyers.


**Build and validate before engineering commits**
* Run ML proof-of-concepts independently: data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, and initial validation, using Python, notebooks, and the data available in nShift's data layer.
* Define the evaluation framework for both ML models and LLM pipelines. For ML features: what accuracy thresholds matter, how to measure model performance in production, how to distinguish signal from noise. For LLM-based features: how to assess output consistency, factual grounding, and quality at scale, where traditional accuracy metrics don't apply.
* Design lightweight experiments that answer the key questions before a full engineering team is committed. Does the prediction accuracy justify the product? Does cross-customer data improve the model significantly? Is the data we have sufficient, or do we need to instrument more?
* Translate POC findings into clear build, kill, or iterate decisions backed by data.


**Partner across data, engineering, and commercial teams**
* Work closely with engineers to define the data models, pipelines, and normalization standards needed to power ML features. You are a customer and co-designer of the data layer, not a passenger.
* Drive integration of data insights capabilities into existing products. Work closly with your PM peers to make this happen.
* Engage directly with customers and prospects across the full spectrum, from small shippers to global enterprises, to validate intelligence use cases: what decisions do they make today that better data would improve? What would they pay for? What do they trust?
* Build the commercial narrative: ROI frameworks, value quantification, and positioning for the target buyer.


**Govern the data responsibly**
* Define the anonymization, aggregation, and consent frameworks that make cross-customer benchmarking legally and ethically sound, and credible to enterprise customers who will ask hard questions.
* Work with Legal and the DPO to ensure data usage within the intelligence layer meets GDPR and contractual obligations. The data asset is only valuable if customers trust nShift to use it appropriately.
* Establish transparency standards for ML-powered recommendations: when does a merchant see why a carrier was recommended? What level of explainability builds trust without revealing proprietary network data?


**What You'll Bring**
**Must-have**
* Hands-on data proficiency across both paradigms: you can build and validate ML proof-of-concepts (data exploration, feature engineering, model training, evaluation) using Python and standard ML tooling (scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, or equivalent), and you can design and evaluate LLM-based analysis pipelines (prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, output quality evaluation). You are not a data scientist or an ML engineer, but you can work like one when the problem requires it.
* Shipped ML-powered products: you have personally driven an ML or data intelligence product from initial hypothesis to production, including defining evaluation criteria, partnering with data engineers and scientists, and making commercial decisions based on model performance data.
* PM fundamentals with commercial depth: 3+ years shipping B2B SaaS products. You can build a business case, define pricing, run customer discovery, and hold direct conversations with enterprise buyers about ROI.
* Data literacy that earns engineering respect: you understand data models, pipeline design, normalization challenges, and the practical constraints of real production data. You can review a data schema and immediately ask the right questions.
* Clear communication across the technical and commercial boundary: you can explain a precision-recall tradeoff to a CPO and a carrier event data use case to a data engineer in the same afternoon, without condescending to either.
* Excellent written and verbal English: you will write strategy documents, ML experiment briefs, customer-facing product narratives, and present to leadership, often in the same week.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with time-series or logistics domain data: carrier performance modelling, routing optimization, ETA prediction, or related domains.
* Familiarity with data platform concepts: data lake houses, feature stores, model registries, observability for ML in production.
* Background in cross-customer benchmarking or network intelligence products, where the value comes from aggregation rather than individual customer data.
* Experience with GDPR-compliant data product design in a multi-tenant B2B SaaS context.
* Nordic or European logistics market experience: carrier landscape, regulatory environment, freight economics.
* Track record of building the first data product at a company, defining standards rather than inheriting them.
